name: Cikgu Suraya
source:
Ali, a high-schooler who just got dismissed from his previous school just start his first class this week. He encountered that, this school is non-ordinary. It's filled with a lot of female teachers, in their 20s and early 30s, brimming with feminine hormones, extremely beautiful, with an air of sexual superiority about them.

Join Ali in his quest to find love with the teachers and figure out what it means to be a man.

[From [url=https://studio32.itch.io/cikgu-suraya]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中生阿里剛被原來的學校開除，這週才到新學校上第一堂課。他很快發現，這所學校很不一般。這裡有許許多多女教師，從二十來歲到三十出頭，個個美麗得驚人，渾身散發著女性荷爾蒙的氣息，在男女之事上也彷彿穩佔上風。

和阿里一起踏上追求女老師的旅程，在尋找愛情的過程中，弄明白成為一個男人究竟意味著什麼。
